Walking Hook.name: Walking Hook
Walking Hook.description: The user opens and closes individual links of one chain around successive overhead rungs within twelve meters. For three turns the chain carries a person in a low sling around corners and past obstructions, shifting the load to the next closed link before releasing the last. The rider stays level even where a swing would strike a wall. The user needs a free hand to guide the chain and the sling stops if the loose end cannot reach the next rung. Strain: severe.
